DIGITAL EVIDENCE INTAKE
Case: CR-05
Item: NP-05 dispatch copy
Format: UTF-8 text and scanned image
Integrity: Both copies agree

Examiner's initial observation:
The text uses ordinary Latin letters, digits, underscores and braces. It does not appear to be compressed or encrypted using a modern cryptographic algorithm.

The margin note refers to a rotation by half of the alphabet. The message preserves its original case and punctuation.

Suggested examination:
- Identify the alphabet length.
- Interpret the half-alphabet rotation.
- Apply the corresponding letter substitution to the complete message.
- Preserve the flag wrapper and punctuation.
